map.恢复码生成器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Recovery code generator. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.熵 = 码数 × 每码字符数 × log₂(字符表长度): Entropy = number of codes × characters per code × log₂(alphabet size)
map.恢复码（备份码）是双因素认证失效时的兜底凭证，要求「离线可存、一次性有效、不可猜: Recovery codes (backup codes) are the fallback credential when two-factor authentication fails, requiring "offline-storable, single-use, unguessable." This tool uses a cryptographically secure random source to generate high-entropy strings, grouped at a fixed length for easy transcription. Three security points: each code is used only once and invalidated immediately after server use; they must be stored as hashes—plaintext leakage equals bypassing 2FA; and users should print or save them offline, not in a plaintext file on the same device. Typically 8–10 codes cover almost all recovery scenarios.
map.开启双因素认证时一并生成并下载恢复码，存到离线位置，作为手机丢失后的兜底手段。: When enabling 2FA, generate and download recovery codes together, store them offline as a fallback if the phone is lost.
map.10 组 `r4k9-m2x8` 格式码，用后失效。: 10 codes in the `r4k9-m2x8` format, invalid after use.
map.恢复码怎么存？: How should recovery codes be stored?
map.服务端哈希存储，用户离线保管。: Stored as hashes on the server; kept offline by the user.
map.用掉一个之后要重新生成吗？: Should you regenerate after using one?
map.不必立即重新生成，但应关注剩余数量：多数平台会在剩余较少时提示补充。若怀疑恢复码: You don't have to regenerate immediately, but watch the remaining count: most platforms prompt for replenishment when few remain. If you suspect leakage, invalidate all old codes and regenerate immediately—this invalidates all previously saved copies. Periodically check how many uses remain rather than finding out they're exhausted when you actually need them.
